review:
Temple Guardians features bears, wolves and owls paying up to 200x in the base game. Five or more money symbols trigger a respin feature with three colours of money symbol.

Purple symbols carry values up to 500x, green symbols are worth the total of all visible purple symbols, and blue symbols combine all purple and green values on screen. The feature starts with three respins, which reset with each new money symbol, and filling the whole grid adds 2,000x. The in-game screens advertise up to 10,000x. The RTP is 96.53%. The layered money symbols make each respin more interesting than a standard hold-and-win.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
